version: 0.4.3
kind: menu
schema_type: composition

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.menu
  name: menu.schema
  description: Canonical menu composition schema with optional headers, item-level borders, and per-item colour roles.

spec:
  target_kind: menu
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: title
    path: title
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: header
    path: header
    type: object
    required: false

  - name: colour_role
    path: colour_role
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: border_pattern
    path: border_pattern
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: items
    path: items
    type: array
    required: true

object:
  title: ""
  header:
    id: ""
    text: ""
    colour_role: ""
    colour_scheme: ""
    border_pattern: ""
  colour_role: "menu_surface"
  border_pattern: "default"
  items: []
